Everything your social media needs.

Pick one service or let us handle all of it. Either way, you approve every post before it goes live.

Content planning

Photos & graphics

On-brand photo shoots, carousels and graphics that look good in the feed and on a phone screen.

💬

Community management

How we work together

Most clients have their first posts live within two weeks.

1

Free audit

We look at your accounts and competitors, and show you what's working and what isn't.

2

Content plan

You get a 30-day calendar with post ideas, captions and a shoot day booked.

3

Create & approve

We create everything. You approve posts in one simple link, from your phone.

4

Post & report

We post, reply and run ads, then send a short monthly report with results.

Monthly plans

No long contracts. Change or cancel any time with 30 days' notice. Ad spend is separate and paid to the platform.

Starter

  • 2 platforms
  • 12 posts a month
  • Captions and hashtags
  • Monthly report
Choose Starter

  • Influencer campaigns

"I used to post when I remembered. Now our Instagram brings in more pre-orders than our website, and I haven't written a caption in a year."

Rosa Delgado, owner of Bloom Bakery

Questions we hear a lot

How much does social media management cost?

Our plans start at $790 a month for two platforms and 12 posts. Most local businesses choose our Growth plan at $1,650 a month, which includes reels, a monthly shoot and replying to comments.

How long until I see results?

Most clients see more engagement in the first month and steady follower growth from month two or three. Paid ads can bring in customers within the first week.

Do I have to be on camera?

No. We can build your content around products, your team or your space. If you'd like to appear, we'll coach you so it feels natural.

Will you post without my approval?

Never. You see every post in advance and can approve, change or reject it from your phone.

Get a free 30-day content plan.

Tell us about your business. Within three working days we'll send a free audit and a month of post ideas you can use, even if you don't hire us.

Email hello@loopsocial.co
Call or WhatsApp +1 (503) 555-0126

# Social Media Marketing

Creator: mmrahmanbappi
Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/social-media-marketing/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

Original MigBits geometric demo artwork and motion controls are separate adaptations. Forms and checkout are frontend demonstrations, not backend services.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
